dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate; the trailing edge follows a deep concave spline starting from the sub-apex and curving sharply inward toward the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded; the highest morphological point exhibits a smooth, non-acute curve with a measurable pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a continuous convex sweep, initiating at a low angle from the dorsal ridge and increasing to a moderate steepness as it approaches the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the fin's visible base at the dorsal ridge to its maximum vertical height is approximately 1.2:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white punctate marks or micro-lesions are distributed across the lateral flank and dorsal fin surface; a singular small notch is visible on the trailing edge near the lower third of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, irregularly shaped dark pigment patch is visible on the flank directly ventral to the dorsal fin.
